check.link.cardForm.text: card is a card reference such as "HI-12" or "#1061": a plain number isn't taken (in a shell, quote "#1061": an unquoted # starts a comment)
check.link.cardForm.note: #1219, SPEC §16.12: a plain number is refused with the forms to use. An unquoted #1061 in a shell is a comment.

check.link.checkForm.text: check is the name of one of the project's checks, such as "typecheck"
check.link.checkForm.note: A check name with characters no check has.

check.link.checkNeedsCard.text: A check runs its project's command for it: name the card too, so Combwork knows the project
check.link.checkNeedsCard.note: A check named by a caller with no project (a script), and no card.

check.link.focusedForm.text: A focused test's check is "focused:<test>", the test's id as its card lists it
check.link.focusedForm.note: HI-1367: a focused test's check names a test id its card lists.

check.link.folder.text: folder is the absolute path of the folder the run runs in
check.link.folder.note: A request whose folder is missing, not absolute or too long.

check.link.noCommand.text: {project} has no command configured for the check "{name}", so nothing was run. cw-progress --check runs the command the project's options give for that name
check.link.noCommand.note: #1220: a check runs the command the project's options give for it. project: its folder name; name: the check.

check.link.noContentRevision.text: {card} has no revision to compare {named} with: leave revision out
check.link.noContentRevision.note: A card on the None platform (#1233): its revision is its declared paths' hash, and it has none yet. named: the revision asked for.

check.link.notACommit.note: named: the revision asked for; folder: where the run runs.

check.link.notCheckedOut.text: {named} isn't what's checked out here ({head} is): check it out first, or leave revision out
check.link.notCheckedOut.note: #1220: a run is checked against what is checked out where it runs. head: that commit, short.

check.link.notContentRevision.text: {named} isn't {card}'s revision now (its paths hash to {hash}): leave revision out
check.link.notContentRevision.note: A card on the None platform (#1233): its revision is its declared paths' hash. hash: that hash, short.

check.link.nothingCheckedOut.text: Nothing is checked out in {folder} to compare {named} with: leave revision out
check.link.nothingCheckedOut.note: folder: where the run runs; named: the revision asked for.

check.link.otherCopy.text: {copy} holds {held}'s revision, not {card}'s: run it there for {held}, or elsewhere for {card}
check.link.otherCopy.note: #1435: a run in a review or check copy is a check of the copy's lease. copy: the copy's name; held: its lease's card; card: the card the run names.

check.link.revisionForm.text: revision is a commit (its id, or a name git knows)
check.link.revisionForm.note: A revision that is empty, too long, starts with "-" or has characters git refs never have.

check.link.revisionNeedsFolder.text: A revision is checked against what is checked out where the run runs: give folder too
check.link.revisionNeedsFolder.note: A revision named with no folder.

check.link.unknownCard.note: card: the reference as the caller wrote it. Another project's card answers as an unknown one does, so nothing of it shows.
